name: first-tool-chunk-missing-name-fatal
description: a first TOOL_CALL_CHUNK must carry both toolCallId and toolCallName; an id alone cannot open a call
kill: let chunk expansion open a tool call with an empty or defaulted toolCallName

expect.errorContains: First TOOL_CALL_CHUNK must have a toolCallName

dotnet.intentional: GAP, not a design difference: EventStreamConverter has no case for TEXT_MESSAGE_CHUNK or TOOL_CALL_CHUNK, so a chunk stream falls through to the pass-through branch. Nothing is expanded into a message and none of the chunk-stream rules are enforced. Pinned here so the gap cannot widen or close unnoticed; alignment tracked separately. With no chunk stage there is nothing to require the first chunk's toolCallName, so the stream is accepted instead of rejected.
